response.overview: A beautiful but cunning college girl (Melody Marks), in need of a job, interviews for the live-in nanny position with an unsuspecting husband (Titus Low). An alluring Melody seems to have the perfect experience for care, so Titus hires her on the spot. He doesn’t know it yet, but he’s soon to find out just how conniving this innocent-looking twat can be. Once Melody settles in, she joins Titus in the living room, parading around in skimpy shorts and a revealing top. That captures his attention and Melody knows it. Her entrancing talents completely capture Titus, who’s now willing to pay any price, including risking his marriage, to continue his secret liaisons with the new live-in nanny.
response.title: The Live-In Nanny 2 (Chapter 1)
